content: Mɛ Pɔl, Silàvɛ anà Tumàtɛ. Bi ban'pà mbɔr akà Ikööŋ a Atɛsalɔnikà akyà kyà Taa Nzam, anà kyà Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ, wɛy kab a ngway anà duu màkäl anà bɛ.
Bi ifàyɔn anki mufuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam ntɔn bɛ banswà mpal ifàlatà bi din uboo a ngyamàkà abi.
Bi ifàyɔbà kusà a Taaràbi Nzam isal ufàtwey nde làkwikilà abɛ, akyà ukwen abɛ, anà kyà muküünà ifàfà unsà làkyän abɛ amu Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Bi ikyàyöb, atɔŋ ukwen Nzam, naa nde kàlasɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Ntɔn, mpal kàlakyään bi Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, làkäl anki u ndaa mpɛl, wɛɛ sye unsà ngwal a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, anà kam aŋàkwo. Bɛ làkyàyöb naa ifà abi byàkäl aben uboo a bɛ, ntɔn ubwaŋ abɛ.
Apan bɛ, bɛ làläb nkääl abi anà yà Mwol, mukyey Ndaa uboo mpay aŋàdiir, anà un'sak kan'fà akà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Abun, bɛ làkyàbulà mbaan ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà banswà u bul a Masɛdwan anà Akayi.
Kyakin, fà akà bɛ, kà nà ndaa a Mwol mpɛl anki yàpää amu Masɛdwan anà amu Akayi, wɛɛ anà làsaŋ a làkwikilà abɛ amu Nzam làkyer apää ntsü yanswà, waa bi undiir afàtɛn watɛy.
Ntɔn ba ŋakwo bàmutà imbäl naa bɛ bi liwɛl abɛn mpal kàyi bi akà bɛ, anà bɛ làwɛy abɛn itɛk ntɔn musyääl Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà wàndandaa,
anà làdilà Mwan ande kan'fà du, Nde akwà kàwiyà uboo a akü, Yɛsu awà kitsuuŋà u nkyɛl a Nzam ayà tsütsü muyà.
